skills.name: (寒氷乍破)
skills.description: Ziye attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: (渊氷三尺)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
When an enemy is inflicted with a Freeze Effect, and Ziye is not inflicted with a control effect, he enters his Divine Water Manifestation form, lasts for 2 turns. The duration of his Divine Manifestation form resets when triggered repeatedly. ;Divine Water Manifestation (水行昭神) : :'''General, Mark''': When attacking, he has a 10% base chance to inflict Freeze, lasts for 1 turn. And when attacking enemies with Freeze Effects, the number of attacks he deals is doubled. When an ally other than himself inflicts Freeze Effects, additional damage equal to 25% of his ATK will be dealt to the same target. This damage will not trigger his Divine Manifestation's effect and cannot exceed 900% of the ally's ATK. ;Freeze Effect (凍結類効果) :When inflicted with effects such as Freeze, Deep Freeze, Frostbound, and Rest in Ice.

upgrades.text: '''Divine Water Manifestation''': Additional damage increases to 50%.
'''Divine Water Manifestation''': Base chance increases to 20%.
'''Divine Water Manifestation''': Additional damage increases to 75%.
When Ziye is in his Divine Manifestation form, his damage dealt to enemies with Freeze Effects is increased by 20%.
